name: BreedingPro
description: A self-contained, browser-based platform for plant and animal breeding experiments. It plans crosses and field trials (11 mating designs; randomized complete blocks, alpha-lattice, completely randomized and augmented designs; power), reads spreadsheets and recognises the mating and field design of a data table, analyses each trial (ANOVA or REML, adjusted means, trial heritability, combined analysis), and estimates combining ability with the four Griffing methods and two models, Hayman-Jinks and Gardner-Eberhart diallel analyses, North Carolina I-III designs, triple test crosses, line x tester and partial diallels with expected mean squares computed for the actual experiment, generation means and variances (scaling tests, joint scaling test, D, H, F and E, heterosis, effective factors), genetic parameters with exact confidence intervals, correlations, path analysis, selection indices and recurrent selection gains, genotype x environment interaction and stability (regression, stability variances, superiority, rank statistics, AMMI with WAAS, GGE biplot, two-stage REML), pedigrees with selfing, animal and sire models with BLUP and REML, Dickerson crossbreeding parameters, genomic relationship matrices, GBLUP, cross-validation and the prediction of untested hybrids; editable publication-quality figures and a report with methods and references.
softwareRequirements: A modern web browser; no installation
